newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Arafat to make a stopover in Rome for talks.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to make a stopover in Rome for talks.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat is to make a stopover in Rome on Friday for talks with Italian Prime Minister Romano Prodi and Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini, an Arafat aide said on Friday.

"The president will make a two-hour stopover this afternoon at Rome's airport on his way from Tunis to Paris to meet the Italian prime minister and the foreign minister," Arafat's spokesman Nabil Abu Rdainah told Reuters.
Arafat is due to meet French President Jacques Chirac later on Friday to brief him on the Middle East held in Washington earlier this week.
